newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: CREDITANSTALT PARTICIPATES IN TELECOM TENDER.
newsitem.headline: CREDITANSTALT PARTICIPATES IN TELECOM TENDER.

text.p: Lithuanian brokerage firm Vilfima said on Wednesday that the Creditanstalt Investment Bank will bid for the tender to become the government's advisor for telecom privatisation.

"The consortium of Creditanstalt, Delotte, Coudert Brothers and Vilfima has submitted its technical offer to become a lead advisor to the government on telecom privatisation," Alvydas Zhabolis, the head of Vilfima brokerage house, told Reuters.
The European ministry said earlier today that it expects no more than eight offers to be submitted before the deadline expires on Wednesday at 6 p.m.
The ministry also said that the commission of the tender might decide on the winner later this week or next week.
State-run Lithuanian Telecom is one of 13 key companies in the communication, transport and energy sectors slated for privatisation.
The government said earlier that the privatisation of the firm might start early in 1998 and that the lead advisor will be excluded from the actual privatisation.
